title: An unaddressed Spanish cipher letter of 8 Jan 1497, in George Lasry's reconstructed alphabet: BnF Espagnol 318 no. 95, f. 122r-v (catalogue item 9)

plaintext.source: George Lasry's decipherment of ll. 1-13 (2022), an image on cryptiana GL.htm (BnF_es318_f122_decipher.png); the rest of the letter read by Michael Brackx (issue #63, 2026)

transcription.source: Segmentation and Ward clustering of f. 122r (targets/esp318/glyphs.py, cluster.py)
transcription.notes: 963 glyphs on 31 lines of f. 122r (NOTES; the glyph file f122r_glyphs.pkl is git-ignored in targets/esp318/); f. 122v (five lines) not done. Touching signs defeat segmentation for about a third. Brackx (Oct 2026) read every line of both pages by eye against Lasry's table on crops of the scan; he counts 33 line bands on the recto. No sign-level transcription of his is in the repository.

system.summary: Lasry's 2022 reconstruction (published by Tomokiyo as an image): a homophonic alphabet of invented signs, one to three per letter, with unassigned signs and code groups written in clear letters (bac bnh bon dah daf dae oht bed dal boo del); scriptio continua.
system.sibling_key: Lasry's no. 95 alphabet (image on cryptiana GL.htm)
system.notes: Split on 14 Oct 2026 from esp318 (the whole volume) under the one-key rule. Lasry's alphabet applies to this letter only. The segmentation pipeline and its outputs stay in targets/esp318/; f122r_reading.md moved here. Two of Lasry's signs corrected here (the n with a cross-tail is M, not Y; plain 7 = D and 7 with a small o = S confirmed). Oct 2026: Brackx proposes values for most of Lasry's 'Unknown' signs (alpha with tail = l, b-bowl with two crossbars = z, 8-shape = a, hooked lightning variant = d, 9. = con or null, p with crossed descender = h) and three signs not in his table (small solid circle = z, a two-crossbar stroke doubling the preceding consonant, a pi/o sign with two crossbars = o); dah and dal are different groups; oht not found on the leaf.

prior_solution.where: George Lasry, May 2022: cryptiana GL.htm publishes his alphabet and, as a second image, his approximate decipherment of ll. 1-13 (BnF_es318_f122_decipher.png); ll. 14-33 and the verso not published

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
tools: cluster.py, montage.py, assign95.py (Ward clustering and labelling)
localseg2.py, viterbi95.py, hybrid95.py (template matching and beam search)
Brackx: crops at 1.5-3x of the scans, read by eye against Lasry's table (Claude Opus 5.5); no solver

solution.what: No. 95 key found: Lasry's 2022 alphabet published as an image by Tomokiyo.
No. 95 f. 122r segmented and Ward-clustered, clusters labelled from Lasry's key (64 % clean clusters).
No. 95 hybrid decode checked by eye: franceses, Francia, que puedan, muy grandes cosas; about two thirds of signs; two Lasry signs corrected.
Band-clipped segmentation and DP template tiling for no. 95; no gain beyond the same two thirds.
No. 95 re-examined: cryptiana GL.htm says Lasry solved the letter itself in 2022, not just its alphabet. The page and the ranking (novelty 5 to 3) were corrected.

Split from the former whole-volume target esp318 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): no. 95, the only letter in Lasry's alphabet, is its own entry, with his credit scoped to it. f122r_reading.md moved here; the pipeline stays in targets/esp318/.

Michael Brackx (issue #63) pointed out the second image on cryptiana GL.htm, Lasry's decipherment of ll. 1-13 (BnF_es318_f122_decipher.png), missed in Sept; NOTES had said no plaintext was published. Both images saved in targets/esp318/lit/crypt/GL/.

Brackx read ll. 14-33 and the four cipher lines of f. 122v with Lasry's alphabet, by eye on crops over about seventeen passes; proposed values for Lasry's Unknown signs and three new signs, each from two or more words; proposed nine letter corrections to Lasry's ll. 1-13. Code groups left unread, with contextual suggestions (def Maximilian I, bed cardinal).

Checked here: Lasry's image transcribed and compared with the issue's quotations of it (ll. 7, 8, 9, 10 entries are blanks over code groups or identical text, not differences); recto ll. 5, 8, 9, 10, 12, 25-26 and verso l. 2 deciphered sign by sign from the scan with Lasry's table: hazen, diz, muy tarde, palabras, haga, Santa Cruz, Alemanna as Brackx has them. Brackx's ll. 14-25 agree with the project's Sept machine reading where they overlap; our l. 12 'me toca' is 'le toca'.

outcome.method_basis: Lasry's 2022 alphabet applied: his own decipherment covers ll. 1-13; Brackx read ll. 14-33 and the verso with it by eye (contributed); the project's Sept reading by segmentation covered about two thirds of the recto, and seven passages were re-deciphered here from the scan.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Not counted sign by sign (no sign-level transcription of Brackx's reading). Recto 963 glyphs by segmentation plus about 130 on the verso; unread: about 18 code-group tokens (10 groups), five burn holes and one word in l. 13 (f122_reading.md).

gaps.item: ten code groups (bac, bon, bnh, def, del, dae, bed, dah, dal, boo), about 18 tokens
gaps.detail: Lasry's table lists them without values and no other letter in this key is known; Brackx's identifications are contextual suggestions only
the paper is burnt through; one image only

gaps.item: one word at the end of l. 13, after the null
gaps.detail: Lasry reads 'a ices', Brackx leaves it unread

gaps.item: the clear date line and signature of f. 122v
gaps.detail: faded clear hand, read only as '... de enero ...'; not cipher

outcome.notes: Spanish, from Italy (a Señoría, probably Venice), Jan 1497: the French bid for the Señoría, a peace mission of the cardinal of Santa Cruz, an appeal for defence; the verso has [def] gone to Germany. Lasry's ll. 1-13 stay the reference; Brackx's corrections to them are proposals pending Lasry (f122_reading.md, NOTES).
